verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's scrape and crawl output comes back in open formats (markdown, HTML, JSON), and the engine is AGPL open source and self-hostable. Neither is a documented way to export a user's account data, such as job history, stored results or settings, and then leave the hosted service. Scrape output formats and self-hosting are adjacent features, not a first-party export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
